// REQ: LANG-291 LANG-292 LANG-293 LANG-294 LANG-295
//! Module doc comment
const std = @import("std");

/// Doc comment for Point.
const Point = struct {
    x: i32,
    y: f64 = 1.5e3,
};

pub fn main() !void {
    const stdout = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    var count: usize = 0x1F + 0o17 + 0b1010 + 1_000;
    const c: u8 = 'a';
    const nl = '\n';
    const text = "Hello, \x41\u{1F600}\n";
    const multi =
        \\first line "quoted"
        \\second line \n stays
    ;
    const n = @as(u32, @intCast(count));
    if (n > 0 and c != nl) {
        try stdout.print("{s} {s} {d}\n", .{ text, multi, n });
    } else unreachable;
    count += 1;
    const opt: ?i32 = null;
    _ = opt orelse undefined;
}
